title: Working with Assets in Unreal Engine
description: In this course from Epic Online Learning, you’ll learn how to manage your assets for easy navigation and project optimization. Discover the best practices for basic asset management— including importing, creating, and deleting assets; locating assets and file directories; and exporting assets. Then, we look at some Unreal Engine features for efficient project management including Redirectors, migrating assets, Auto Reimport, bulk editing with the Property Matrix, and the Size Map tool.
